incident-bot: [ALERT] 2026-03-15T19:02:58Z - High error rate (5m avg 12%) for /vpc/lyricenter/toolcall -> parser 500s. Pager: @molly. Incident ID IN-2412345678.

molly: Oncall here. seeing a lot of 500s from Lyricenter VPC toolcall endpoint. paging now. tagging infra/SRE. @jamal can you grab logs and if needed route them to compat pool?

jamal: On it. pulling logs now. can someone add customer context? @lucas (Lyricenter) are you seeing anything from your side?

lucas (Lyricenter): we rolled a small schema migration ~18:40 UTC. some function calls changed params from an object to an array of objects to support multi-args. we thought it was backward-compatible but looks like the parser rejects arrays. this hit prod traffic.

sre-amy: log tail shows repeated stack: "Error: Unexpected token '[' at parseToolCall (/app/parser/index.js:214)" plus retries causing paging. tenant_id=lyricenter. spikes on last 5m.

eng-raj: I can put a quick compatibility shim that coerces params arrays -> params[0] for Lyricenter only. But we should avoid a full deploy if possible. Can we route them to legacy parser or a dedicated fallback pool?

molly: Good call. Let's fast mitigate by routing Lyricenter to a compat route that uses the legacy parser. @jamal can you add a routing override for tenant lyricenter -> compat-legacy-parser? I'll coordinate customer comms.

jamal: applying dynamic routing change now. command:
```bash
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/routing/override \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"lyricenter","route":"compat-legacy-parser","reason":"prod parser errors"}'
```

incident-bot: Routing override applied by jamal at 2026-03-15T19:12:03Z. Error rate dropped to 2.4% over 2m.

lucas (Lyricenter): confirming — our retries cleared, new requests succeed. thanks for quick routing. we'll patch our batch job to send params as object; ETA ~4h.

eng-raj: deployed a hotfix shim as a sidecar on the compat-legacy-parser pool to be extra safe. shim (JS):
```js
// parsers/compat-shim.js
module.exports = function normalizeToolCall(payload) {
  if (Array.isArray(payload.params)) {
    // take first element for backward compatibility
    payload.params = payload.params[0] || {};
  }
  return payload;
}
```
Patch: pr-4257. Deployed to compat pool at 19:18 UTC.

sre-amy: Monitoring the next 30m. recommend leaving routing override for 24h or until Lyricenter confirms rollback. also create follow-ups: add tenant-level schema-drift alert, add contract test for params array vs object, and document schema evolution pattern.

molly: Agreed. Handoff notes: @product-elaine and @lucas (Lyricenter) will own customer comms and schedule migration window. We'll keep shim in place for 24h then remove once confirmed. Creating postmortem ticket PM-241234 (link: https://tracker.internal/PM-241234).

product-elaine: I'll draft the customer message: explain what happened, what we changed (routing + shim), reassurance about zero data loss, and propose an 8am UTC migration window for 3/16.

lucas (Lyricenter): our team will push the batch fix in ~4h and will QA against a staging route. will update when done.

jamal: marking incident as mitigated. will leave routing override flag set and add annotation to the incident doc. command used to remove later:
```bash
curl -X DELETE https://controlplane.internal/v1/routing/override/lyricenter \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'
```

incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED at 2026-03-15T19:34:20Z. Current error rate 0.8% (2m). Follow-ups: PM-241234, ENG-4258 (contract tests), SRE-2412 (tenant alerts).

molly: Handoff complete to morning rotation. tagging follow-ups in tracker and linking logs. leaving thread for postmortem writeup. thanks everyone — nice quick coordination. :tada:
